summary: Implemented the window title feature by reading and editing files only; nothing was run or committed. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the formatter entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) gated only on is_terminal, returning True/False, with the required docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200; one test each was added to tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Tests were not run, so the Console test's win32 skip runs after the call. The CHANGELOG wording is my own.
